scientific_context: Matrix Gauss congruences force prime-power Perrin pseudoprimality to descend in the exponent. Combining this with the current A173656 completeness statement below 10^10 gives exactly two unrestricted prime-power Perrin pseudoprimes below 10^20 and no minimal-restricted prime-power examples in that range.
limitations: The 10^20 finite classification relies on OEIS A173656's explicit completeness statement for primes below 10^10, which is not re-enumerated here. The classical matrix Gauss congruence is prior mathematics. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; the main residual risk is equivalent coverage in Adams-Shanks (1982) or Adams (1987), whose complete full texts were not directly inspected.

artifact_inventory.description: Standalone exact modular verification using independent matrix and polynomial representations of the Perrin sequence.
Deterministic residues for the three primes currently listed in A173656 and the even-prime check.
